Categorize transactions with keyword rules

Source: R/apply_rules.R
apply_rules.Rd

Matches each rule's Pattern (a regular expression, case ignored) against the transaction Description. The first matching rule wins; unmatched rows get "Other". From the Tracking spending chapter.

Usage

apply_rules(df, rules)

Arguments

df

A data frame of transactions with a character Description column.

rules

A data frame with character Pattern and Category columns, in priority order.

Value

df with a Category column added (or replaced).

See also

Other tracking spending: subscription_opportunity_cost()

Examples

transactions <- data.frame(
  Description = c("SAFEWAY #123", "NETFLIX.COM", "SHELL OIL", "ATM FEE")
)
rules <- data.frame(
  Pattern = c("safeway|trader joe", "netflix|spotify", "shell|chevron"),
  Category = c("Groceries", "Subscriptions", "Gas")
)
apply_rules(transactions, rules)
#>    Description      Category
#> 1 SAFEWAY #123     Groceries
#> 2  NETFLIX.COM Subscriptions
#> 3    SHELL OIL           Gas
#> 4      ATM FEE         Other
